title: HealthSignal Federated Learning Data Handoff Contract
description: Formal contract defining privacy-approved aggregate training features handed from Person 1 (Data Layer) to Person 2 (Federated Learning Layer). Raw patient records and PII are strictly prohibited.

syndrome_category.description: Standardized syndrome category code referencing syndrome_master.json (45 standardized categories).

service_count.description: Aggregated daily count. Mandatory privacy rule: Any cell with 1 <= service_count < 11 is suppressed to 0 or omitted.

rolling_3d_mean.description: 3-day rolling mean of past aggregate counts.

rolling_7d_mean.description: 7-day rolling mean of past aggregate counts.

rolling_7d_std.description: 7-day rolling standard deviation of past aggregate counts.

growth_rate_7d.description: 7-day demand growth percentage calculated with zero-division safety.

pharmacy_lead_t2.description: Exogenous leading pharmacy OTC dispensing demand lagged by 2 days (t-2).

coverage_ratio.description: Data completeness and reporting coverage ratio for the node.

data_completeness.description: Completeness score indicating whether cell was unsuppressed (1.0) or suppressed (0.0).
